snippet.title: ZigZag - Android Gameplay
snippet.description:
ZigZag - Gameplay Android HD

Description -   Stay on the wall and do as many zigzags as you can!
Just tap the screen to change the direction of the ball. Try not to fall off the edges!
How far can you go?
Download - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.zigzaggame
